versions.changelog:
- Initial release of science-agent-recommend skill.
- Provides personalized AI agent recommendations for various research domains.
- Covers 131+ projects across 10 categories and 32 skill hubs.
- Uses a decision tree to guide users by research domain, workflow, or task.
- Includes tables of top-recommended agents and tools with install info and links.
- Offers resources for skill hubs and API access for browsing all projects.
